text: dsh-agent-bridge 是面向 DSH Web 工作区的会话集成插件，可在工作区浏览 Claude Code、Codex 会话，并可选启用 Pi。它把外部会话列表接入侧栏或工作区会话源，打开后可查看对话并继续发送消息。面板还提供本地终端、文件与 Git 工作区，以及搜索、定时跟进等操作。适合希望在 DSH 中集中管理本地编码 agent 会话的用户；需要安装相应 CLI，语音功能则需自行配置兼容的语音服务。

dsh-agent-bridge brings Claude Code and Codex sessions into the DSH web workspace, with optional Pi support. Browse and continue transcripts, search sessions, and use local terminal, file and Git workbench tools. Install the matching CLI; voice features need a configured speech service.
我想在 DSH 工作区里查看并继续 Claude Code 的会话。
能不能把 Codex 的历史会话放进 DSH 侧栏，方便按项目打开？
Can I browse and continue my Claude Code and Codex sessions from the DSH workspace?
dsh-agent-bridge 的功能「工作区会话浏览」：把外部 agent 会话列表接入 DSH 工作区或侧栏页面。用户可按项目查看、搜索并打开会话，进入面板继续对话。
dsh-agent-bridge 的功能「语音输入与朗读」：配置语音服务后，可从麦克风录音并转成文字，也可请求服务合成回复语音播放。
dsh-agent-bridge 使用语音功能时会把录音或待朗读文本发送到配置的语音服务地址；可选 bearer key 从指定环境变量读取。
dsh-agent-bridge 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 10 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-agent-bridge README · dsh-agent-bridge：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Use your **Claude Code** and **Codex** sessions inside **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** (DSH). They appear in the DSH Workspace browser next to your DSH sessions, grouped under the same project folders. You can open them, keep talking, and pin, rename or archive them there.

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with DeepSeek, Anthropic or OpenAI.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Features：- **One sidebar for all your agents.** Claude Code and Codex sessions are listed in the stock DSH Workspace browser under their project folder, with a small Claude or Codex mark on each row.
- **The stock row menu works on them.** Pin, Rename and Archive use DSH's own menu items, pin indicator and rename dialog. Pins and archives survive restarts.
- **Continue any session.** Opening a row shows the full transcript. You can send messages, stop a turn, answer permission prompts and questions, pick the model and reasoning effort, and attach images. Claude runs through the Claude Agent SDK and Codex through `codex app-server`, so the sessions stay compatible with the CLIs.
- **Same controls as DSH.** Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line. A running session shows DSH's own spinner in its row. For Claude and Codex, the permission menu beside the attach button chooses Default (ask each time), Read Only, Workspace Write or Full Access; Full Access needs confirming first, the choice is kept per engine, and scheduled messages always use Default. Claude's thinking summaries appear above its replies once each thinking block completes.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x, desktop app or `dsh web`. It is tested with 0.2.1.
- Node.js 22.19 or newer. DSH ships its own Node.js.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code), installed and logged in.
- [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) is optional. Without it, only Claude sessions are listed.
- Pi is optional and tested with 1.4.0.
- Developed and tested on macOS. Linux should work; Windows is untested.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Install：Choose the DSH profile you run. The desktop app uses `desktop`; `dsh web` uses `web`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wiiwings1988/dsh-agent-bridge
```

Restart DSH. The desktop app ships the `dsh` command at `/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh` on macOS.

To uninstall, run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-bridge` and restart DSH.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Configuration：Every option has a default, so no configuration is required. To change one, add an entry to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, for example `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: agent-bridge
  config:
    claudeExecutable: /path/to/claude
    codexEnabled: false

dsh-agent-bridge README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `claudeExecutable` | `claude` | Claude Code command or path. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`, then in `~/.local/bin`, `~/.claude/local`, `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin`. |
| `codexEnabled` | `true` | List and run Codex sessions. |
| `codexExecutable` | `codex` | Codex command or path, looked up the same way. |
| `codexApprovalPolicy` | `untrusted` | `untrusted` or `on-request`. |
| `codexSandbox` | `workspace-write` | `read-only` or `workspace-write`. |
| `codexHistoryTurns` | `20` | How many recent Codex turns to load when a session is opened. |
| `piEnabled` | `false` | List and run Pi sessions. Pi does not ask before acting. |
| `piExecutable` | `pi` | Pi command or path, looked up the same way. |
| `permissionMode` | `default` | Claude permission mode: `default`, `acceptEdits` or `plan`. |
| `allowedTools` | `[]` | Claude tools that run without asking. |
| `sessionLimit` | `100` | Most recent sessions listed per engine. |
| `defaultCwd` | home folder | Folder for new sessions when none is chosen. |
| `memoryFile` | empty | A file appended to the system prompt of new Claude session

dsh-agent-bridge README · Data and privacy：- The plugin reads sessions where the CLIs keep them: `~/.claude` (or `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`), `~/.codex`, and, when Pi is on, `~/.pi/agent/sessions` (or `PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR`, `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`). It never uploads them.
- Rename, fork and delete change the CLI's own session files, so the CLIs see the same result.
- Pins, archives, drafts and scheduled messages are stored in `~/.dsh/agent-bridge/state.json`.
- The terminal, file and git tabs act on your machine with your user's rights. They are served only to the DSH UI, behind DSH's own login token.
- Voice sends audio and text only to the speech endpoint you configure.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Known limits：- Very long sessions use a lot of memory: opening a Claude session reads its whole file three times, and a Pi session twice. A 67 MB session peaks near 500 MB per request.
- A Pi session with a malformed entry does not open.
- Pi: commands run with `!` and compaction summaries are not shown in the transcript, a custom `sessionDir` in Pi's settings is not followed, and file edits have no diff view.

dsh-agent-bridge README · Development：The build reuses the DSH client bundle preset and type definitions, so it needs a DeepSeek Harness source checkout. Clone this repository three folder levels below the checkout root:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git dsh
cd dsh && pnpm install && pnpm run build:artifacts
git clone https://github.com/wiiwings1988/dsh-agent-bridge.git local/plugins/dsh-agent-bridge
cd local/plugins/dsh-agent-bridge && pnpm install

dsh-agent-bridge README · Development：- **Run your build:** `dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD` installs the working copy into a profile.
- **Unit tests:** run one file at a time, for example `node --import tsx/esm --test tests/graft.test.mjs`.
- **End-to-end tests:** `tests/e2e*.mjs` drive a running `dsh web` instance with Playwright. Pass the instance through `DEV_BASE` (URL) and `DEV_HOME` (its `DSH_HOME`). `tests/fixtures` holds stand-ins for the Claude and Codex executables.
dsh-agent-bridge README · Development：`lib/` is committed, so installing from GitHub needs no build step. Rebuild it before committing source changes.
